nodes.content: Enable cross-lingual morphological inflection transfer to low-resource languages with grammatical feature combinations absent from source languages.
requirements: Use at most 200 labeled inflections per target language; evaluate on unseen lemmas.
Exceed matched-budget multilingual fine-tuning exact-match accuracy by five percentage points on source-absent feature combinations.

nodes.content: CompoMorph learns feature-wise edit operators from source paradigms, composes source-absent feature bundles, and calibrates using 200 target inflections.
Can CompoMorph infer target-specific affix ordering for source-absent feature bundles from 200 labeled inflections?
Pairwise affix-order calibration from 200 target examples raises unseen-lemma exact match on source-absent bundles ≥5 percentage points over matched-budget fine-tuning.
Split UniMorph by lemma; train CompoMorph’s affix-order calibrator on 200 target forms; compare source-absent-bundle exact match against budget-matched multilingual fine-tuning.
Run five-seed UniMorph lemma-disjoint trials across four targets, comparing calibrated CompoMorph’s source-absent-bundle exact match against matched-budget multilingual fine-tuning.
Across four UniMorph targets, unseen-lemma source-absent-bundle exact match averaged 42.1% versus 40.0% for matched-budget fine-tuning (+2.1 points).
Defer affix-order-only calibration because its +2.1-point gain misses the five-point threshold; investigate target-specific morphophonological edits.
After deferring affix-order-only calibration, classify five-seed UniMorph errors as affix misordering or stem alternation on source-absent bundles.
UniMorph Error Atlas v1 tabulates affix-order and stem-alternation failures by target language and seed, with unseen-lemma examples.
Do stem alternations account for over 50% of CompoMorph’s source-absent-bundle errors in UniMorph Error Atlas v1?
Audit 400 stratified errors in UniMorph Error Atlas v1, adjudicating stem-alternation versus affix-order labels and computing per-language shares.
Among 400 adjudicated source-absent-bundle errors, stem alternations were the primary cause in 228 (57%); affix misordering in 116 (29%).
With 200 target forms, feature-conditioned stem rewrites will raise CompoMorph’s unseen-lemma source-absent-bundle exact match to ≥45.1% versus 40.0% fine-tuning.
Can 200 target forms identify transferable stem-rewrite rules that improve exact match on unseen-lemma source-absent bundles?
MetaStem adds context-conditioned stem rewrites to CompoMorph’s feature composition, meta-trained on source paradigms and adapted with 200 target forms.
Meta-train MetaStem on source paradigms, adapt with 200 target forms, then test unseen-lemma source-absent bundles against matched-budget fine-tuning.
Use UniMorph Error Atlas v1 to stratify unseen-lemma source-absent-bundle comparisons of CompoMorph, MetaStem, and matched-budget fine-tuning.
MetaStem achieved 47.3% unseen-lemma source-absent-bundle exact match, versus CompoMorph’s 42.1% and matched-budget fine-tuning’s 40.0%.
Using UniMorph Error Atlas v1 stem-alternation strata, ablate MetaStem’s rewrites; measure unseen-lemma source-absent-bundle exact match across four targets.
On Error Atlas stem-alternation strata, disabling MetaStem’s rewrites raised unseen-lemma exact match from 38.2% to 41.0%.
Do MetaStem’s rewrites overgeneralize across unseen lemma classes, causing the 2.8-point ablation reversal on stem-alternation cases?
On unseen lemmas, MetaStem’s incorrect-rewrite rate is ≥2× higher for stem-final classes absent versus present in target training.
Stratify unseen UniMorph lemmas by stem-final class presence in 200 target forms; bootstrap MetaStem incorrect-rewrite rate ratios.
Gate MetaStem’s unseen-lemma stem-class audit on its 7.3-point overall gain and 2.8-point ablation reversal; bootstrap incorrect-rewrite ratios.
On unseen lemmas, MetaStem’s incorrect-rewrite rate was 46% for training-absent stem-final classes versus 19% for represented classes (2.42×).
Retain MetaStem’s 7.3-point overall gain, but disable rewrites for unrepresented stem-final classes after the ablation reversal and 2.42× error risk.
ClassGate-MetaStem gates stem rewrites by stem-final classes observed in 200 target forms, falling back to CompoMorph otherwise.
Does ClassGate-MetaStem reduce errors on unrepresented stem-final classes without erasing MetaStem’s 7.3-point overall advantage?
On unseen lemmas, ClassGate-MetaStem raises unrepresented-class exact match ≥3 points over MetaStem while retaining ≥45.1% overall source-absent-bundle accuracy.
Adapt ClassGate-MetaStem with 200 target forms; compare five-seed unseen-lemma subgroup and overall exact match against MetaStem and fine-tuning.
Implement approved gating; compare ClassGate-MetaStem, MetaStem, and fine-tuning on five-seed, 200-form UniMorph unseen-lemma subgroup and overall exact match.
ClassGate-MetaStem achieved 44.5% versus 40.8% MetaStem exact match on unrepresented-class unseen lemmas; overall, 48.1% versus 40.0% fine-tuning.
Bootstrap per-language confidence intervals for ClassGate-MetaStem’s unrepresented-class gains over MetaStem and overall gains over fine-tuning, using approved-gate results.
Language-balanced unrepresented-class gains averaged +2.1 points (95% bootstrap CI: +0.4 to +2.8), below the predicted +3.
Retain ClassGate-MetaStem for its +8.1-point overall advantage; reject the ≥3-point language-balanced subgroup expectation given +2.1 points.
On held-out targets, ClassGate-MetaStem gains ≥1.5 language-balanced unrepresented-class points over MetaStem and ≥5 overall points over matched-budget fine-tuning.
On held-out UniMorph targets, compare retained ClassGate-MetaStem with MetaStem and matched-budget fine-tuning using 200 forms; measure unseen-lemma subgroup/overall exact match.
Using +8.1 overall/+2.1 subgroup findings, test ClassGate-MetaStem against MetaStem/fine-tuning across four held-out UniMorph targets: 200 forms, unseen-lemma source-absent bundles.
Across four held-out targets, ClassGate-MetaStem gained +1.9 language-balanced unrepresented-class exact-match points over MetaStem and +6.2 overall over fine-tuning.
Approve retained ClassGate-MetaStem: held-out +6.2 points over fine-tuning exceeds the five-point goal; +1.9 subgroup points supports gating.
PhonoGate replaces ClassGate-MetaStem’s binary gate with confidence-weighted nearest-class stem rewrites, retaining CompoMorph fallback under low similarity.
Tune PhonoGate’s similarity threshold within 200 target forms, then compare unseen-lemma source-absent-bundle exact match against ClassGate-MetaStem and fine-tuning.
Using UniMorph Error Atlas v1 strata, tune PhonoGate with 200 target forms; compare unseen-lemma source-absent-bundle accuracy against approved ClassGate-MetaStem.
On four original UniMorph targets, PhonoGate reached 49.4% unseen-lemma source-absent-bundle exact match versus ClassGate-MetaStem’s 48.1%.
Does PhonoGate’s +1.3-point gain persist for unseen-lemma source-absent bundles on held-out targets with unfamiliar stem-final classes?
On held-out targets’ unfamiliar stem-final classes, PhonoGate improves unseen-lemma source-absent-bundle exact match ≥1 point over ClassGate-MetaStem.
Freeze PhonoGate’s original-target threshold; evaluate unfamiliar stem-final classes on four held-out UniMorph targets with 200 forms and unseen lemmas.
Using PhonoGate’s +1.3-point original-target result and ClassGate-MetaStem’s held-out baseline, compare unfamiliar-class source-absent-bundle accuracy on unseen lemmas.
Across four held-out targets, PhonoGate reached 43.0% versus ClassGate-MetaStem’s 41.4% unfamiliar-class unseen-lemma source-absent-bundle exact match.
Adopt PhonoGate over approved ClassGate-MetaStem: it gains +1.3 points originally and +1.6 on held-out unfamiliar classes.
Audit adopted PhonoGate on four held-out targets: compare unseen-lemma source-absent-bundle exact match against matched-budget fine-tuning with 200 forms.
PhonoGate Held-Out Audit v1 reports per-language unseen-lemma source-absent-bundle exact match against matched-budget fine-tuning, with 200-form budgets.
